app_fee.value: Graduate applicants pay a separate nonrefundable application fee for each program; the international fee is $100.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are only for McNair Scholars; no other waiver is listed for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are available exclusively for McNair Scholars.

gre_general.value: The Graduate College pages disagree on whether most programmes require the GRE; each programme record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: While Iowa State University does not have a university-wide requirement for the GRE or GMAT, most graduate programs require one of these tests.

also.quote: While Iowa State University does not have a university-wide requirement for the GRE or GMAT, most graduate programs do not require one of these tests.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate College minimum is TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new scale for exams taken on or after 21 January 2026 (79 before that).
toefl_min.quote: Internet-Based Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL iBT): 79 (for exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026); 4.5 (for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: The Graduate College minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; programmes can set higher.

english_waiver.value: Only degrees from English-speaking countries waive the English test, and India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: If you have not earned a degree from an English-speaking country, you must provide official scores from one of the following exams.

also.quote: These countries recognize English as an official language: ... Zambia, Zimbabwe.

notes: Graduate College rules for all programmes. The Graduate College says both its minimum and the programme minimum must be met. Fields with no Ph.D. programme on the official list: datasci (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning and Data Engineering are Master's only) and bme (no Biomedical Engineering Ph.D. on the list). Blocked or refused by the proxy: https://www.grad.iastate.edu/ (502 on CONNECT), https://admissions.iastate.edu/ (502), https://catalog.iastate.edu/, and department hosts (physics, phys, chem, math, ece, me, stat, bbmb, cs, ge, ccee .iastate.edu), including https://www.cs.iastate.edu/graduate-admissions-deadlines. Deadlines on the programme pages are day and month only; the year is inferred by the brief's cycle rule.
